'''Winsafra VSC Dark Jedi Lightsaber Combat BEATDOWN!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 8 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 FirstMove Winsafra DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Who care's about lightsaber combat when you could beat em to death the old fashioned way?

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The trick to this deck is the new virtual card, Blaster Rack. You should get either a vader or maul in hand, and use this card to pull their lightsaber for a quick drain.

You Want to Get people out fast and early to drain quickly. Evezan, Dannik and Boba Fett are for backup. Make sure not to drop to the core. use all the dark jedi you have to their full potential, and make sure to leave Darth Sidious alone at the coruscant docking bay, and if your opponent drops a jedi down to annoy you, drop evezan, and disarm/operate on him during the next control phase and put him out of play. if you play against We Have a Plan, make sure to take the thrown room fast and strong. Against any space deck, make sure you start draining fast, becasue that's all your  going to do, or possibly deal with bombs. Use Dannik Jerriko to his full potential, he can ruin a game fast, against any deck centered around any one character like There is Good in Him,  Profit, or We Have a Plan.

If you have any ideas to help with this deck, please share them, i'm always looking for good ideas :)

Carl

p.s. i'd add a second dannik jeriko, but i only have 1 :P
